summary: Revolutionary captain of the Northampton County Light Dragoons and nephew of Johann Casper Doll; John's 1st cousin 8 times removed if the Doll line holds.
bio:
Capt. Casper Dull was born in 1748, a nephew of Johann Casper Doll. In the Revolution he served as cornet, the equivalent of second lieutenant, of the Northampton County Light Dragoons in the Pennsylvania militia, and later held the rank of captain. After the war he received donation lands in Butler County. He died in 1829 at McVeytown, Mifflin County, Pennsylvania, where he is buried.

In 1934 a monument to him was erected on his uncle's grave at Plainfield, which is why Johann Casper Doll has sometimes been mistaken for a Revolutionary captain himself. If the Doll connection holds, Casper Dull was John's 1st cousin 8 times removed.
